newsitem.title: CANADA: Pacalta Resources sets private placement.
newsitem.headline: Pacalta Resources sets private placement.

text.p: Pacalta Resources Ltd said on Tuesday it entered into a private placement with a syndicate of Canadian underwriters for a private placement of five million special warrants at C$7 each.
Certain Pacalta directors and officers agreed to acquire 350,000 warrants in the issue, the company said.
An option, which expires September 12, to distribute a further one million warrants has been made available to the underwriters at the issue price, it said.
Each warrant will be exchangeable for one Pacalta common share, it said.
The company said net proceeds would be used to acquire the remaining 40 percent City Investing Co Ltd, as well as fund the development of Pacalta's Ecuadorian projects.
